_comment: Original art allowed under overrides/kubejs/assets/epca/** and assets/spore/** (tools/visual/art_check.py). Each entry: {"path": "kubejs/assets/epca/optifine/random/entity/<file>.png", "author": "...", "method": "drawn from scratch on the UV layout / procedural generator ..."}. Never add recolours or edits of EPCA or Spore textures: those are generated locally by tools/visual/etf_variants_local.py.
